comparator.name: History
comparator.sourceNotes: Supported first two years total 120 EC: 60 EC required in year 1, and 20 EC required plus 40 EC of restricted choices in year 2. One current-menu illustration selects one 5 EC lecture, one 10 EC research seminar and one 5 EC sources-and-methods course per semester. Both first-year research seminars must pass before BA2 research seminars; the study-advice norm and individual module entry conditions also apply. Future annual menu availability is not guaranteed. No retired route, old third-year unit or repeat version is added. Verify the adopted revised third-year 60 EC allocation, final research/thesis structure and entry/progression rules for entrants from 2025 onward, or an authoritative cohort bridge. Current 2026–2027 regulations remove their formal routes and defer the BA3 transition to the 2027–2028 regulations. The current catalogue labels its third year old style; a forward-year request returns the same current record. The retired General History route and its 15 EC thesis/30 EC choice structure cannot be certified for the revised cohort.

audience.programmeDescription: Leiden History studies political, social, economic and cultural change from antiquity to the present, with attention to Europe and its connections with the world. Source criticism, historical research and written and oral argument are central. The revised first two years include digital humanities and a sequence of research seminars.
audience.comparisonExplanation: The displayed 120 EC covers the supported first-two-year structure and an illustrated set of second-year choices. The revised third-year requirements still need verification before a complete UCR comparison can be approved. Potential history-based UCR directions are preserved for further assessment; this is not an approved comparison or a no-match conclusion.

curriculum.limitation: The displayed 120 EC comprises 60 EC required first-year study and 60 EC of second-year required study and restricted choices. The choices illustrate the currently published menu, rather than guaranteeing future annual offerings. Formal routes do not apply to entrants from 2025 onward. The revised third-year 60 EC, including its final research structure and progression rules, remains unverified; old-route units have not been carried over. Both first-year research seminars must be passed before second-year research seminars. The usual study-advice threshold is 45 EC with at least one first-year research seminar passed; individual course conditions also apply.
